BarberShop.title: BarberShop
BarberShop.description: Represents a barber shop within the SaaS application.

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: Represents an appointment scheduled at a barber shop.

barberShopId.description: Reference to the BarberShop where the appointment is scheduled. (Relationship: BarberShop 1:N Appointment)

serviceIds.description: References to Services provided during the appointment. (Relationship: Service N:N Appointment)

Barber.title: Barber
Barber.description: Represents a barber working at a barber shop.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: Represents a service offered by a barber shop.

barberShopId.description: Reference to the BarberShop that offers the service. (Relationship: BarberShop 1:N Service)

duration.description: Duration of the service in minutes.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support a multi-tenant SaaS application for barber shops, prioritizing security, scalability, and ease of debugging. Authorization Independence is achieved through denormalization of ownership. Each BarberShop and its associated data (Customers, Barbers, Services, Appointments, FinancialRecords) are segregated under a path based on the BarberShop's ID, facilitating secure and efficient querying. This approach eliminates the need for complex `get()` calls in security rules, improving performance and simplifying authorization logic.

The structure supports QAPs through structural segregation.  Listing barbershops is limited to the owner of the barbershop. Listing of customers, barbers, services, appointments, and financial records is constrained by the barberShopId, ensuring that users can only list resources associated with a barbershop they have access to.
